comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Contract correction accepted. Remove all natural-language semantic failure classification. Introduce and propagate an explicit typed semantic_failure_category with only budget_exhausted, outcome_unknown, and authority_publication_failure; derive it from exception/state types at the source boundary. Error prose becomes display-only. Missing, unknown, legacy, or contradictory prose without a valid structured category fails closed as generic incomplete. Add full runner-to-evidence/Report/workbook/summary/action regression coverage and verify arbitrary prose cannot alter category.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Typed semantic failure contract implemented. Natural-language/status/outcome inference is removed: only exact semantic_failure_category values budget_exhausted, outcome_unknown, or authority_publication_failure are accepted from structured packets, and missing/invalid/legacy categories fail closed as generic incomplete with safe review guidance. Exception-source mapping is type-only: SemanticBudgetExceeded; SemanticOutcomeUnknown or Tactus ModelAttemptOutcomeUnknown; and specific SemanticAuthorityPublicationError or Report publication/integrity types. Broad semantic authority and generic errors remain incomplete. Coordinator ledger load, initial persistence, and commit failures now raise the specific publication type, while missing authority, unauthorized model, replay conflicts, and unrelated authority errors do not. The typed field propagates through runner row, nested and aggregate diagnosis coverage, durable Report evidence, stakeholder Portfolio/outcomes, workbook, and summary actions. Contradictory/arbitrary prose cannot change it.
